# Movie Standings

> The year's best movies, ranked by AI every night, with every movie's rise and fall charted across the year. Built from TMDB and MDBList data. Updated nightly; poll at most once a day.

Each night AI scores every movie released in the last 365 days (0-100, how strongly it would recommend it). A movie's standing score is a running average of its nightly scores, and the top 20 are the standings.

## Files

- [movies.json](https://movies.mickschroeder.com/movies.json): tonight's standings, 20 movies best first. A JSON array of objects with exactly these fields (same format as the StevenLu popular-movies lists):
  - `title` (string)
  - `tmdb_id` (integer, The Movie Database id)
  - `imdb_id` (string like `tt1234567`)
  - `poster_url` (string URL to a TMDB poster image)
  - `genres` (array of snake_case strings, e.g. `science_fiction`)
- `https://movies.mickschroeder.com/ranks-YYYY.json`: every night's standings for a calendar year, e.g. [ranks-2026.json](https://movies.mickschroeder.com/ranks-2026.json). An object with `year`, `days` (array of `{ date: "YYYY-MM-DD", ids: [tmdb_id, ...] }`, best first, oldest day first) `movies` (map of tmdb_id to `{ title, imdb_id, poster_url, release_date }`) and `scores` (map of tmdb_id to standing score, 0-100, after the latest night).

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/mick-schroeder/movies.mickschroeder.com): MIT licensed, started as a fork of [sjlu/popular-movies](https://github.com/sjlu/popular-movies)
